notes.title: Multiplayer Update (0.14)
notes.content:
It has been a busy few months of hard work and QA, but Multiplayer at last makes it into Planetation! In v0.14 you can play with up to 8 players in one world, all exploring and exploding at the same time! That's not all though, this update is packed with a heap of extra content as well as a visual upgrade. Let us know what you think!

[h3]Major Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 8 player co-op multiplayer
[list]
[*] [b]Note: Expect bugs - lots of them. We are particularly interested in what feels slow or laggy or bad, so give it a go![/b]
[*] Right-click "Join Game" via the Steam friends list
[/list]
[*] Reworked Abandoned Bunkers (previously Outback Harmsteads)
[list]
[*] Now appears randomly throughout the Outback, instead of in their own sub-Region (meaning they can now spawn on hillsides and creeks). Builds a circular fence at a random distance around the bunker, then populates the interior with buildings and crops
[*] Added Hay Bales, Silos, Watchtowers, Outhouses, and Fuseboxes
[*] Added a bunker puzzle to the central building
[/list]
[*] Polished Fibergrass
[list]
[*] Split Fibergrass into Fibergrass atop a Fibergrass Trunk
[*] Added 2 and 3 headed variants of the Fibergrass Trunk
[*] Always gather Fibergrass even if the sweetspot is missed
[*] Increased sweetspot miss damage from 5 to 15
[/list]
[*] Added player death screen and respawn option
[list]
[*] Dead players now drop a Gravestone, which contains any basic items they were carrying
[/list]
[*] Added new bold edge postprocess effect
[*] Added new Spring Sprout landmark to the Mesa
[*] Added new Quartz Sliver landmark to the Mesa
[*] Increased spawn rate of Quartz Spires in the Mesa by ~25%
[*] Reduced jetpack speed from 600 to 550 and greatly reduced energy efficiency by ~55%
[*] Reduced maximum player interaction distance from 700 to 400
[*] Removed the starting player energy battery
[*] Fixed dropped items (mostly quartz dust and harvested crops) spawning below the ground
[*] Changed the Torch toggle button from right click to left click
[*] Changed the starting time of day from 0.2 to 0.1
[/list]

[h3]Minor Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added team names to the M.A.T.E. Scan
[*] Added new fuse particles and sound effect to lit Boomshrooms
[*] Added distance labels (in meters) to the compass
[*] Added fluid fill bar to inventory item icons such as the Jerrycan
[*] Fixed sound effects having a noticeable delay when first played
[*] Increased the brightness of night time
[*] Fixed Ironberry Crops always showing as Stunted (red widget)
[*] Changed 'teleport' console command to 'move'
[*] Merge 'teleport-region' and 'teleport-biome' console commands into 'teleport-to' and 'teleport', which can now take a location OR a region/biome name OR a player name OR "mech"
[*] Added 'break' and 'repair' console commands, which kill and revive the player/tractormech
[*] Added 'complete-quest' console command, to instantly complete a quest
[*] Fixed Protatoes using Consume on right click instead of Eat
[*] Fixed Bonebark Trees sometimes not spawning any Bonebark
[*] Improved performance of the Outback ambient wind particle effect
[*] Fixed Genehouse legs being visible in scans
[/list]

notes.title: Update - 0.13
notes.content:
We hope everyone had a great holiday! We're back to development and today we're excited to introduce abandoned Harmsteads throughout the Outback. These derelict farms have been long abandoned by their owners (likely deceased), and are full of loot ready for you to make yours. These Harmsteads represent a huge addition to the game and we intend to expand them significantly over the next couple of updates.

[h3]Major Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added first pass of randomly generated Abandoned Harmsteads to the Outback, with new Codex entries
[*] Added Wood and Stone gatherables to the Mesa biome
[*] Added throttling to background landmark generation when the frame rate is low
[*] Fixed intermittent and extremely random crash
[/list]

[h3]Minor Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved Dark Embolus consistency of attaching to other landmarks
[*] Fixed janky Composter lid animation
[*] Improved Wood Gate terrain deformation
[*] Added Wood Gate and Baked Protato sound effects
[*] Added uncommon item loot effect
[/list]

notes.title: Update - 0.12
notes.content:
We've returned from the convention circuit with a heap of in-person playtest feedback! This update is our first major step towards improving player quality-of-life, with more improvements to come alongside the next couple of patches.

[h3]Major Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Replaced M.A.T.E scanner job line with the Codex
[*] Added descriptive error messages for many important actions
[*] Added function key shortcuts (F1-F3) to pilot the drone in each mode
[*] The Q key now leaves your M.A.T.E., in addition to entering it
[*] Changed Seed/Protato Plant action key from Right Mouse to Left Mouse
[*] Added Health bars for damaged Landmarks
[*] Changed the Low Gravity effect of a Geode to linger after destroying its Dark Amber
[*] Polish the player inventory
[list]
[*] Made the difference between the Action Bar and Backpack more obvious
[*] Shows (in small form) what's in the Backpack while it's closed
[*] Made the Action Bar selection highlight more obvious
[*] Automatically places non-interactive items (mostly Materials) in the Backpack rather than the Action Bar
[*] Hidden subtractive inventory notifications
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Minor Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed being able to claim job rewards while piloting the M.A.T.E.
[*] Fixed being able to scan the M.A.T.E.
[*] Improved scan results for the player and the Tractormech
[*] Increased Tractormech maximum health (100->1200)
[*] Renamed gatherable Wood to Bonebark Branch
[*] Removed the "Fix Your Ride" job
[*] Added Corruption attribute to the Dark Amber/Coffer/Core
[*] Fixed Dynamite Throw having extreme gravity
[*] Increased the amount of Dynamite it takes to destroy a Cracked Boulder or a Geode Dome (but not the amount of TNT)
[*] Increased dropped item lifespan (1min -> 5min)
[*] Delayed dialogue timers by 3 seconds so they don't ruin the mood
[/list]

notes.title: Update - 0.9
notes.content:
This is our biggest patch yet! And the longest in coming. If you only want the patch notes then skip to the bottom.

[h3]Engine Upgrades[/h3]
Planetation has been in development for a couple of years now and in that time we've only upgraded our [url=https://www.unrealengine.com/en-US]game engine[/url] once (to Unreal Engine 5.0) and our [url=https://voxelplugin.com/]voxel plugin[/url] never (we started already at 1.2). This is because both are a lot of work, and as a small team we have to be [i]extremely[/i] efficient with our time. The voxel plugin upgrade alone would require a complete rewrite of our world generation systems, and we were never able to justify that.

Unfortunately, living in the past like that comes with its own problems. Because of unresolved engine bugs and outdated feature sets, it can end up taking twice as long to create something half as good than if we could leverage more modern supporting technology. For example, upgrading our game engine would give us [url=https://docs.unrealengine.com/5.0/en-US/lumen-global-illumination-and-reflections-in-unreal-engine/]more powerful dynamic lighting[/url] and [url=https://docs.unrealengine.com/5.2/en-US/introduction-to-iris-in-unreal-engine/]faster and more robust networking capabilities[/url], among other things. A full rewrite of our world generation for the voxel upgrade would also allow us to 'clean the cruft', by building in more advanced generation techniques that we never even knew existed the first time around.

This is (part of) what we've been working on for 0.9. The upgrade is done, and while Planetation might [i]look[/i] mostly the same on the surface - every single update from here out will reap the benefits from our time spent behind the scenes. Before we get to the patch notes though, here's one quick example of the power of our new world generation system.

[h3]World Generation 2.0[/h3]
We're extremely proud of Frontier (world gen 2.0), and in the coming weeks we'll post a full technical breakdown here for you too to salivate over. We've significantly improved performance, greatly reduced memory requirements, but most importantly we now have more control than ever before over our voxels, landmarks, and foliage.

This is especially true when generating underground environments such as the Geode introduced here in 0.9, something that would have been impossible before this upgrade. Giant cracked boulders guard the entrance to these important caches of wealth. Blow your way in with a well placed bundle of TNT, follow the spiraling tunnel down while keeping an eye out for sharp crystals of quartz, and then defeat a subterranean gravitational disturbance in order to earn your first Geneseed - and grow your first Iron.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/795853533890871306/1153586878696661012/2023-09-19-070224-Aumbra.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/795853533890871306/1153589978748690472/2023-09-19-071443-Aumbra.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/795853533890871306/1153590147108057138/2023-09-19-071523-Aumbra.png[/img]

[h3]Major Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fully implement Mesa Geodes (access with TNT to earn an Iron Geneseed)
[*] Add Tracer genemachine to the Genehouse, to point you in the direction of a Geneseed
[*] Add Cracked Boulders to the Outback that can be destroyed with TNT
[*] Add screen flash in direction of damage taken
[*] Add UI toasts for looting uncommon and rare items (such as the Iron Geneseed)
[*] Add cooking?
    [*] In unrelated news, you can now eat a Protato or a Baked Protato without already being mortally wounded
[*] Reduce TNT explosion radius by 50% and add slight thematic delay
[*] Fix the Jetpack consuming energy at only 50% of the rate intended
[*] Polish job sequence for simplicity and to introduce the Tracer genemachine
[*] Polish the Drop Pod intro sequence
[*] Update Wood Gate art and add functional swinging doors
[/list]

[h3]Minor Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduce number of taps required to destroy Quartz (3->2)
[*] Improve placement of TNT, so you can put it on walls or on top of destroy-able rocks
[*] Hide inventory notifications when adding or removing items entirely within your own inventory
[*] Add 'teleport-biome [mesa/outback]' and 'teleport-region [regionID]' console commands
[*] Mostly fix landmarks spawning inside of other landmarks
[*] Award Stone when a Geode Dome is broken
[*] Add sound effects for the Genehouse doors, for watering crops, for the Fling Pad, and for the initial TNT detonator button press
[*] Restore the player to full health when they "die"
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Beta Begins!
notes.content:
[i]Transmission Received
Designation: Ol' Gal
Sector: Unknown

G'day. Is this darn thing on? Bugger, it's blinking. Let's give that another go. M.A.T.E, from the start please.

G'day. This is Ol' Gal, writing in from Perdition. Long time reader, love your stuff. First time writer though. Well, dictator. As in I'm dictating, not a dictator. Blast it, again please M.A.T.E.

G'day. This is Ol' Gal, from Perdition. I'm writing in about Darkhounds. They're everywhere, you see - on Perdition I mean, of course you don't know what a Darkhound is. Why is this so bloody hard? Again, M.A.T.E.

G'day. I'm Ol' Gal and I've got a problem with Darkhounds. That's like a big, mean dingo if you stuck purple crystals all over it. They don't smell too great either but then they probably can't run a bath, water being so scarce and all. Plus they got no hands. [b]M.A.T.E![/b]

G'day. Ol' Gal here and is that smoke? My cookies![/i]

[h1]Closed Beta[/h1]

We're super excited to announce the Closed Beta for Planetation! It represents a huge leap forward from the Alpha of the past, and we can't wait to hear what you think. Over the next three weeks we'll be sending out invites, so [url=https://discord.gg/Qz7pSt4]head on over to our Discord server[/url] to join in the fun!
[url=https://discord.gg/Qz7pSt4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805161/0d31c5be1550412c74d28077f5a44739f8823263.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Major Features[/h2]

[h3]Jobs[/h3]
Now, when you complete a designated task such as building the Autobarn or stabilising a Geneseed, you'll be given a variety of rewards - usually Dollarweed Seed Bags alongside some currently relevant materials or items.

[h3]Farming[/h3]
We've extended the farming system with the addition of the Farm Plot, a building that tills the surrounding ground with nice convenient rows for you to plant your crops. We've also added the Watering Cannon, a watergun that makes watering your crops extra [i]violent[/i], as well as cool new ways to gather and carry water (the Groundwater Pump and Jerrycan). Finally, handy status indicators will appear over nearby crops so you can check on their growth at a glance.

[h3]Geneseeds[/h3]
Sick of growing normal stuff like explosive mushrooms and literal money? Then it's time to grow Iron! Geneseeds are otherwise-unremarkable objects that have slowly stewed in the fetid blood of Alluvian for years, corrupting and changing them. Find an Iron Geneseed out in the wild, then bring it back to your Genehouse to clean off that gunk so that you can grow it. Be careful though, Alluvian does not easily let go that which he has taken.

[h3]Biome Regions[/h3]
Biomes are now split into thematic sub-biomes called "Regions". To begin with there are three Regions within the Outback and one in the Mesa, but we intend to extend this system greatly in the coming months.

[h3]M.A.T.E.[/h3]
Manufacture. Assemble. Terraform. Exterminate. The M.A.T.E is everything you might want in a trusty robot companion! You can launch this hoverdrone at any time, and use it to explore or to build your biggest structures.

[h2]Minor Features[/h2]

[h3]Jetpack[/h3]
Why walk places when you can fly, and possibly explode?

[h3]Crafting[/h3]
Put materials in and get cool new items out! You already know how this works.

[h3]Fencing[/h3]
Place wooden posts and gates that automatically link up to build fences around your farm!

[h2]New Buildings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Boundary Flag
[*] Composter
[*] Farm Plot
[*] Genehouse
[*] Smeltery
[*] Spike Barricade
[*] Storage Drawer
[*] Wood Gate
[*] Wood Post
[*] Workbench
[/list]
[h2]New Crops[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dollarweed
[*] Ironberry
[*] Nitro
[*] Protato
[/list]
[h2]New Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dark Core
[*] Dynamite
[*] Farm Plot
[*] Fiberglass
[*] Groundwater Pump
[*] Iron
[*] Iron Slag
[*] Ironberry
[*] Jerrycan
[*] Nitro
[*] Plastic Sheet
[*] Watering Cannon
[/list]
